title: Ing Bulong keng Angin
intro: Isipan me ing metung a labuad nung nukarin ing e mayayakit ampo ing mayayakit misasanmetung la, at makatalakad ka king arap ning metung a pigura king pusu ning metung a kayarian a e kalupa da reng aliwa. Ing kaladwa ayni atin yang belwan a e na abut ning ordinaryung abut, mag-utus yang pwersa na aisip da mu reng aliwa. Makanyan man, agyang ing pekamasikan malyari yang mibaba king metung a malating lelangan, at ing katutwan malyari yang manatili a makasalikut angga king mitakdang panaun. Ninu ining pigura na ing legacy na echo ya keng milabas a panaun?
clues: Mirinan kung metung a kayarian a e na akamtan ning ninuman kaybat ku.
Memana kung belwan at kabiasnan ibat keng kaluguran kung pengari.
Ing angin atyu lalam ning kanakung utus, maglakbe ya king kanakung utus nung nukarin ku buri.
Aintindian ku ing pamagsalita da reng ayup, at ila ring magsilbi king kanakung hukbu.
Tinanggap kung balita king metung a malating ayup tungkul king metung a reynang sasamba king aldo.
Ing kamatayan ku menatili yang makasalikut anggang ing metung a lelangan ning yatu kinanan ne ing kanakung tukud, at kanita mu abalu da reng jinn na e da balu ing e mayayakit.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
